verdict.rationale: The API introduction page links a "Download Zoho Books OpenAPI Document" (openapi-all.zip, a 340KB+ zip of the full OpenAPI corpus), which was live-verified as downloadable. The REST API is documented as covering all web-client operations, so the spec covers a broad surface. The probe's 404s at conventional discovery paths (/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) do not contradict this: the spec simply lives at a docs-linked zip rather than a standard path. Missing for 10: discoverability at standard well-known spec paths, and independent third-party corroboration of the spec's completeness and accuracy.
